verification.opt_in_enabled_command: AUTOSUT_DOCKER_INTEGRATION=1 AUTOSUT_RUN_DOCKER_TESTS=1 python -m pytest tests/test_lifecycle_signal_integration.py tests/test_subdetermination.py tests/test_supervised_docker_sweep.py -q
verification.meaning: The four default-skipped tests are opt-in Docker integration tests, not hidden failures: they pass when Docker is available and the opt-in flag is set. They are gated so the default suite needs no Docker daemon.

policy.development: The four opt-in integration skips are acceptable when Docker is unavailable.
policy.qualification: A qualification run must enable the opt-in flags so every integration gate executes; a skip caused by an unavailable in-scope backend is then a blocker, not an acceptable skip.
